title: immediately.run roadmap item — entry frontmatter
description: The roadmap-ITEM branch of frontmatter.schema.json, extracted here (R3-545) so the root file types the four kinds and references this branch by $ref. It is the SHAPE an item's `status:` coordination lock and its required work-item keys (`prs:`, `depends_on:`, …) enforce; `status: done` is legal only in the archive (liveDoneAudit in check-docs-wiki.mjs, R3-393). The `id` pattern is the SAME string `frontmatter.schema.json` uses for `depends_on` items — keep the two in sync.

itemId.description: A roadmap item id: R3-NNN, with an optional letter suffix for a split (R3-51a) and an optional digit after it (R3-274e1).
